items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Dutch Schultz was the biggest gangster in town at that time. He and his men had rented Connie's Inn.

ctx.x: That was a lot of money then?
I never made that many tips before in my life. Dutch Schultz. I had a $50 tip one time. The fellow didn't know it. __________ didn't know it, either.
Did Alley Ross one time conduct the Henderson band?
